name: 7209-sharedprefix-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 query / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, vocab 128256, max_position_embeddings 8192, bf16, 8.03B params -- all off the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, bounded at 1024 requests with a 2400 s safety cap, warmup the first 25% by completion.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn: one shared 512-token prefix (`prefix_buckets`, prefix_count 1, so every request gets the same one) plus 1024 unique prompt tokens in and 512 tokens out, min = max on both so the counts are exact. Greedy decoding (temperature 0.0). The engine is launched with `enable-prefix-caching: true` and `dtype: bfloat16`; see `configs/vllm-config.yaml` for the full launch declaration, which the Serve block below abbreviates.
purpose: An 8B chat assistant answering 1.5k-token prompts sharing a common instruction prefix, 64 concurrent streams, one H100.
launch:
# The engine's command line. Driven by guidellm 0.7.3 in-process through the `vllm_python`
# backend, which builds AsyncEngineArgs directly from these keys: at this vLLM an unknown key is
# a TypeError at engine construction, so do not add knobs from a later version.
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
enable-prefix-caching: true
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
max-num-seqs: 256
